name: Maur Raincaller
summary: Maur Raincaller is a tauren resident found residing in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Connected to the natural and spiritual life of the plains, he assists the village elders and watches over local matters affecting the herds and wild beasts.

sections.title: A Resident of Bloodhoof Village
sections.body: Situated near the heart of Bloodhoof Village on the shores of Lake Stonebull, Maur Raincaller serves his community by attending to regional ecological and beast-related concerns. Like many who bear the mantle of Raincaller, he pays close attention to the balance of the elements and wildlife across the fertile plains of Mulgore. After a bite from the fearsome strider Mazzranache left his wound infected, Maur turns to capable young travelers to gather the animal parts he needs for a remedy.

faq.answer: Maur Raincaller is a tauren living in Bloodhoof Village within the verdant grasslands of Mulgore. He acts as a local quest giver, tasking adventurers with managing unruly wildlife in the surrounding area.

faq.q: Where can I find Maur Raincaller?
faq.answer: He can be found standing outdoors among the tepees and hearth fires of Bloodhoof Village, situated just south of Thunder Bluff along the eastern bank of Lake Stonebull.

faq.q: What trouble is Maur dealing with?
faq.answer: Maur was bitten by Mazzranache, a fearsome strider from his grandfather's stories, and the wound has become infected. He asks adventurers to bring him parts from the wolves, cougars, plainstriders and swoops of Mulgore so he can make a remedy.

angles.text: For young tauren stepping out of Camp Narache, Maur provides an opportunity to protect your people's ancestral lands from wandering predators and disruptive beasts.
Maur provides an early hunting test, sending you after the wolves, cougars, plainstriders and swoops of the open plains for the parts he needs to cure Mazzranache's venomous bite.
